sources.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Administration Act 1992

sources.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992
sources.fact: Compilation C2026C00364, compilation 12, in force 1 September 2026. Section 10 requires a reasoned auditor opinion on levy, additional levy and Part 7 reimbursements within 6 months of year end. Schedule 1 clause 19(4) disapplies sections 5 and 10, and takes them never to have applied, for the employment of an employee covered by a Board-approved unpaid levy payment arrangement; clause 19(2) disapplies sections 6, 7 and 9(2) for the unpaid levy on those wages; clause 12 requires the arrangement to carry its own auditor's report on the amount it specifies. Clause 28(5) switches sections 6, 7 and 9(2) back on for the outstanding unpaid levy amount once the employer fails to comply under clause 28(2). Read the in-force compilation each time.

sources.title: Determining eligible wages, issued 21 June 2024
sources.fact: Non-casual Formula B includes overtime, penalties and non-reimbursement allowances before applying 75%. Category-specific salary and casual methods and insurer-payment distinctions must be preserved; the casual method changed on 1 January 2024.
